change: added

change: added
hook: "mahr-TEER": on a pillar, a stone carving of the young MARTYR saint holds a palm branch and smiles peacefully: MARTYR
note: This is a cognate: it looks and sounds close to the English word, so the picture simply shows it. Un martyr (une martyre) is a martyr; a palm branch is the martyr's sign in art. Also figuratively: jouer les martyrs, to play the martyr.

change: added

note: La pitié is pity. Avoir pitié de quelqu'un: to take pity on someone. Careful: faire pitié can be negative, 'to be pitiful' (c'est à faire pitié, it's pathetic). Sans pitié: merciless.

note: This is a cognate: it looks and sounds close to the English word, so the picture simply shows it. Une confession is a confession, both the sacrament and any admission (la confession d'un secret). Also a religious denomination (de confession catholique).

change: added
hook: "ray-kohn-see-lyah-SYOHN": two little brothers who quarreled hug and make up: RECONCILIATION, while their teacher smiles: RECONCILIATION

hook: "kohn-tree-SYOHN": a CONTRITE boy hangs his head, holding out the pieces of the flowerpot he broke: CONTRITE

note: This is a cognate: it looks and sounds close to the English word, so the picture simply shows it. Pardonner: to forgive (pardonner à quelqu'un). Pardon! is also 'Excuse me!' or 'Sorry?' when you didn't hear.

change: added
